spec_features.evidence: experiment.py:139 `sandbox = tempfile.mkdtemp(...)` fresh per run; build_task(...).materialise(sandbox) creates fresh files (base.py:90); experiment.py:154 `shutil.rmtree(sandbox)` in finally. Each AgentLoop.run builds a fresh history list (loop.py:60-63), so no transcript/state carries across runs.

spec_features.code_justification_quote: executes the agent loop for each cell in an isolated temp sandbox ... keep the sweep alive on a single failure

spec_features.evidence: loop.py:130-141: `if self.config.debrief_after_rigged and not task.solvable:` constructs the debrief text and SENDS it via `self.backend.generate(history, ...)`, storing only in record.metadata['debrief'] (not record.turns, so excluded from scored transcript). spec_features.evidence: No-train-against-it: NOT in code anywhere (grep finds no train-related logic) - prose only. spec_features.spec_quote: the point is to induce *repeated genuine failure*, not to gaslight
